## Why

The author-facing guides are the ONLY place the SC/AC split was ever described as a real
distinction — `rebar explain plan` currently tells container authors they need
`## Success Criteria` on top of the universal `## Acceptance Criteria` floor. That prose is the
source of the divergence this epic removes; leaving it in place after the gates change would
instruct authors to write a heading nothing reads.

## What

Rewrite the author guide and user docs for the collapsed vocabulary, including the leaf/container
section rule that motivated the split.

## Scope

- `src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md:58,76` — the leaf-vs-container section rule
  ("Container ... needs `## Success Criteria`" and "Containers additionally: `## Success
  Criteria` + the child decomposition"). Both must be restated so containers are described by
  what actually differs: they still need `## Acceptance Criteria`, plus a child decomposition
  that COVERS it (G3), and they defer testing to children.
- `docs/user-guide.md:219,230`
- `docs/llm-framework.md:407`

## Approach

Rewrite rather than substitute. A literal rename of line 58 would read "Container needs
`## Acceptance Criteria`", which is true of every ticket and so says nothing — the container
guidance has to be re-expressed as the decomposition/coverage requirement. This is the one place
in the epic where the edit is editorial rather than mechanical.

Note the guide is packaged and surfaced by `rebar explain plan`, so it is a shipped artifact,
not just documentation.

## Testing

- `rebar explain plan` renders the updated guide with no SC vocabulary.
- `pytest tests -k "guide or explain"` green.
- Manual read-through that the container guidance still tells an author what containers need
  DIFFERENTLY from leaves (coverage + decomposition), i.e. the section did not become vacuous.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `grep -rniE "success[ _-]criteri(a|on)" src/rebar/_guides/ docs/user-guide.md docs/llm-framework.md` returns no matches.
- [ ] `rebar explain plan` exits 0 and its output contains no SC vocabulary.
- [ ] The guide's leaf-vs-container section still states a container-specific requirement
      (child decomposition covering the parent's acceptance criteria, testing deferred to
      children) rather than collapsing to "containers need Acceptance Criteria".
- [ ] `make lint` and the full pytest suite pass.
